newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner to redeem $300 mln n senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner to redeem $300 mln n senior notes.

text.p: Time Warner Inc said Thursday it would redeem all $300 million outstanding principal amount of 10-3/4-percent Senior Notes due 2002, which were issued by its subsidiary, TWI Cable Inc, formerly named Cablevision Industries Corp.
The company said the redemption date will be January 30 and the redemption price per $1,000 principal amount will be $1,053.75.
Interest due on the notes will be paid on January 30 in the usual manner to holders of record of the notes at the close of business on January 15, it said.
